records.title: Dominant-Layer ZO: A Single Layer Dominates Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs
records.reason: ZO fine-tunes only a selected decoder layer using forward-only updates; reports up to 4.52x training speedup, but this is training efficiency rather than inference quantization. SmoothQuant lineage is only adjacent.

records.title: P2-DPO: Grounding Hallucination in Perceptual Processing via Calibration Direct Preference Optimization
records.reason: VLM preference optimization for hallucination/perception quality; no inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Training a Predictive Coding Network on ImageNet using Equilibrium Propagation
records.reason: Predictive-coding network trained on ImageNet via equilibrium propagation; no LLM inference/compiler optimization contribution despite torch.compile lineage.

records.title: Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects
records.reason: Object-centric Gaussian world-model dynamics for robot manipulation; PyTorch graph compiler citation is incidental, no LLM inference contribution.

records.title: Training Prompt Matters: State-Adaptive Optimization for Robust Fine-Tuning
records.reason: State-adaptive prompts improve fine-tuning robustness/forgetting; ZeRO lineage is unrelated to the paper’s training-prompt objective and it does not optimize inference.
